item.name: CONTRACT

description.content:
Test ID: API-001
Category: CONTRACT
Objective: Verify the documented method, path, JSON-object member representations, and reviewed successful-reset response oracle with a fully valid reset request.

Preconditions / Setup:
After the initialized SUT is running, the direct-SQLite fixture seeds poola-api-001@example.test with reset_token stored as exact TEXT 100001. A registered account exists. The direct-SQLite fixture provides the exact six-digit OTP above, bound to that account; the OTP is unexpired and unused. The workflow confirmation equals newPassword, but no confirmation field is added to the API body.

Reviewed request input:
Send POST /api/reset-password with Content-Type application/json and body {"email":"poola-api-001@example.test","resetToken":"100001","newPassword":"NewPassword123!"}, substituting fixture values that satisfy the stated account and OTP preconditions.

Reviewed expected result:
The request returns 200 OK under the reviewed external successful-reset oracle. Do not assert any response body, media type, header, field, message, token, session effect, notification, or exact persistence timing.

Specification basis:
CR-001, CR-002, CR-003, CR-004, CR-005, CR-006, CR-007, CR-011, and CR-012 in reviewed contract-report.md (approved SHA-256 DF8A9603E9125CBB7E50C1579A8FC039F921EC52AD047FDEDA7B2195DD40DA4A); API specification lines 44-52; FR-03 lines 46-60; FR-01 line 34; SEC-07 line 284; reviewed external assumptions: Content-Type application/json and 200 OK for normal success.

Content-Type application/json and 200 OK are reviewed external assumptions, not source-defined response facts. The body is limited to the three documented API members. Exact response content and confirmation-password API mapping remain unspecified Provisional specialist ID: CONTRACT-P001.

item.name: API-078 - reviewed multi-request flow

description.content:
Test ID: API-078
Category: CONTRACT
Objective: Verify that otherwise valid JSON text sent as text/plain receives a 4xx client-error response and is rejected without consuming the OTP.

Preconditions / Setup:
After the initialized SUT is running, the direct-SQLite fixture seeds poola-api-078@example.test with reset_token stored as exact TEXT 100078. A registered account has a valid, unexpired, unused six-digit OTP and a conforming new password. The same OTP is used for both requests and can be retried immediately after the first request.

Reviewed request input:
Step 1: Send POST /api/reset-password with Content-Type: text/plain and the raw request body {"email":"poola-api-078@example.test","resetToken":"100078","newPassword":"NewPassword123!"}. Step 2: Using the same email and OTP, send POST /api/reset-password with Content-Type: application/json and JSON body {"email":"poola-api-078@example.test","resetToken":"100078","newPassword":"NewPassword123!"}.

Reviewed expected result:
The text/plain response has a 4xx client-error status (400 through 499); no status outside the 4xx class is accepted, and the request does not consume the OTP. 415 Unsupported Media Type is the preferred human/external HTTP expectation, but any safe 4xx rejection, including 400 Bad Request, is acceptable and must not automatically be reported as a SUT bug based on the supplied requirements. The application/json retry succeeds with the normal 200 status under the human/external HTTP oracle.

Specification basis:
Main_Report.md section A.7 human case API-078; api_specification.md lines 44-52 document the JSON request representation but specify no response status for POST /api/reset-password.

Assumptions / Notes:
Human-authored robustness case. Acceptance of the 4xx class, the preferred 415 status, and 200 for normal success are human/external HTTP expectations, not specification requirements. The successful same-OTP retry supplies evidence that the first 4xx rejection left the OTP intact.

Deterministic SQLite fixture (seed after SUT startup):
- poola-api-078@example.test: reset_token TEXT 100078

Step 2: Using the same email and OTP, send body {"email":"poola-api-080@example.test","resetToken":"100080","newPassword":"Aa1!aaaa"} with Content-Type: application/json.
